definitions.definition: A structured network of senior leaders connected by a relevant shared identity and recurring opportunities to exchange useful knowledge and relationships.
A network connecting senior leaders across multiple markets through shared identity, clear membership standards and recurring opportunities to build trusted professional relationships.
A recurring, facilitated group in which chief executives examine decisions, challenges and leadership responsibilities with peers.
A moderated discussion in which every participant has a credible opportunity to contribute to a defined executive question.
